title: dev-team doctor result
description: The `result` of the engine's `doctor` command: which tools are present and what the plugin does without the missing ones. It never contains account details.

node.description: The Node.js version running the engine.

dataDir.description: The folder where the engine keeps its machine-local files, or null if none could be worked out.

dataDirIsFallback.description: True when no data folder was given and the default under the home folder was used.

dataDirWritable.description: True when the engine could write to that folder.

tools.description: For each tool the engine looks for: whether it is present and its first version line.

version.description: The tool's first version line, or null when absent.

codexLoggedIn.description: True when Codex is installed and reports a login. No account detail is ever read or shown.

fallbacks.description: Plain-words notes on what the plugin does without each missing piece.
